name: Folders
tip: Folders you share, served straight from disk. Each has a permanent id (its key); contents can change but the id stays. Others browse it by id and get the same folder structure. Tap a folder to open it, then tap subfolders to navigate.

children.name: folder_add_disk
children.label: Share a disk folder
children.tip: Pick a directory on this device to share; files are served from disk (not copied), keeping their folder structure. The master key is kept inside that folder.

children.name: folder_new
children.label: New folder
children.tip: Create an empty folder you own (you hold its master key).

children.name: folder_open_id
children.label: Open by id
children.tip: Browse any folder by its id (hex) or npub address.

children.name: folder_back
children.label: My folders
children.tip: Back to the list of folders you share.

children.name: folder_manage
children.label: Manage
children.tip: Download all, auto-sync, and owner edits (rename, link, admins, rescan).

children.name: folders
children.tip: Your folders, or — when one is open — its subfolders and files. Tap a subfolder to go in, or ".." to go up.

name: Info
tip: The open folder's share link, plus how often its files have been shared and how recently.

children.name: copy_key
children.label: Copy link
children.tip: Show and copy this folder's share link (npub) so others can open it.

children.name: copy_id
children.label: Copy id (hex)
children.tip: Copy the raw hex folder id.

children.name: info_log
children.label: Folder info & statistics
children.tip: Share link, file count and size, and serve counts over time.

name: Edit
tip: Edit the open (or selected) folder's metadata. Reached from a folder's ... menu.

children.name: edit_tags
children.label: Tags
children.tip: Comma or space separated; 50 characters total.

children.name: folder_save
children.label: Save
children.tip: Sign and publish the new metadata.

name: Sharing
tip: Make your folders available to others.

children.name: provide
children.tip: Two transports: Blossom HTTP for devices on the same local network, and BitTorrent for anyone across the internet.

children.name: blossom_on
children.label: Share on the local network (Blossom)
children.tip: Serve GET /<sha256> over HTTP so nearby devices can scan this port and fetch your files. NOSTR-Blossom compatible.

children.name: uploads_on
children.label: Accept uploads (PUT /upload)
children.tip: Allow others to store files on this device. Uploads are keyed by their own hash, so nobody can overwrite an existing file.

children.name: seed_on
children.label: Seed over BitTorrent (internet)
children.tip: Create a deterministic torrent for every archived file and announce it to well-known public trackers + the DHT, so devices on other networks can fetch it from the swarm via its magnet link.

children.name: share_apply
children.label: Apply sharing
children.tip: Start/stop the transports with the settings above.
